install full xcode with simulators
set up android studio and the sdk on my mac

Set up this Mac for mobile development.
expected_behavior: asks iOS, Android, or both BEFORE installing anything, and installs only the selected track(s)
iOS: installs full Xcode (App Store or xcodes; ~40-50GB free space warning), then sudo xcode-select -s to Xcode.app, xcodebuild -license accept, -runFirstLaunch, and simulator runtime download
Android: android-studio cask, first-run SDK wizard, ANDROID_HOME=~/Library/Android/sdk plus platform-tools/emulator/cmdline-tools PATH lines (grep-guarded), sdkmanager --licenses
verifies per track: xcodebuild -version / simulator boots; adb --version / emulator arm64 image
flags manual steps: App Store sign-in for Xcode, Apple Developer account tiers (free = 7-day provisioning), license acceptances

cases.prompt: cocoapods/xcodebuild says 'requires Xcode but active developer directory is CommandLineTools'
expected_behavior: runs sudo xcode-select -s /Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer rather than reinstalling anything
explains this recurs after macOS upgrades and fresh Xcode installs (the pointer resets to CLT)

cases.prompt: react native doctor is failing all over - node ok but ios and android both red
expected_behavior: works through the RN checklist: watchman via brew, full Xcode active via xcode-select, CocoaPods present if the project uses it (noting maintenance mode / precompiled frameworks trend), Android env vars + JDK 17+ for Gradle
notes Expo is the officially recommended default for new RN apps (framework-less setup only when needed)
re-runs the doctor and reports remaining failures honestly

cases.prompt: android emulator on my m3 - which image and how
expected_behavior: creates an AVD with an arm64-v8a system image (never x86_64 on Apple Silicon)
notes acceleration is automatic via Hypervisor.framework (no HAXM) and verifies with emulator -accel-check or by booting the AVD
